research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Automat is researching systems and methods for managing a personalized online experience, focusing on a dialog system for engaging in a dialog with a user. Using conversational input, the method and system for engaging in a dialog with a user determine appropriate response text and products to recommend, generating a tailored ecommerce interaction. Overall, Automat is developing dialog driven product recommendation and online experience personalization technologies.
